title: “Shivers and Butterflies” by Ollee Owens captures the eternal spark of love
htmlContent: In her latest song, “Shivers and Butterflies,” Ollee Owens captures the exciting feeling of love, from the nervousness of a first date to the deep connection that can last for many years. The inspiration for the song came from a late night conversation with her partner of 25 years. “Shivers and Butterflies” reflects on young love and the kind that makes your heart race and leaves you feeling a bit shaky. But it also shows that those feelings can still come back even after going through a lot together over the years. The song features a smooth, soothing melody paired with Owens’ rich voice, drawing listeners into its warm and reflective embrace. This track reminds us of what love can be beyond just the initial excitement. https://open.spotify.com/track/2LC3CnCnbZypqDBPZuXX6v?si=WGs50axgSrqE1uN2HaR_5g Owens expresses love through every part of the song. It’s a perfect fit for couples who still share secret glances and remember those early butterflies while appreciating the comforting bond they’ve built. “Shivers and Butterflies” is about experiencing love right now, showing that some feelings never truly go away, they transform into something even more beautiful.
